purpose: Full German RhymeLab core: usage-ranked corpus vocabulary followed by dictionary-only long tail

dictionary.name: German Wiktionary via Kaikki/Wiktextract
notes: The raw URL is a moving current snapshot, not an immutable versioned URL.
The local bootstrap computes SHA-256 and records response metadata on first download.
Once downloaded, the local gzip is reused unless --refresh-kaikki is explicitly supplied.
Only compact normalized RhymeLab shards are intended for Git.

ordering.first: all Leipzig-observed surface forms ordered by equal-weight mean per-million usage across News/Wikipedia/Web
ordering.tail: German Wiktionary surface forms not observed in the usage corpora, usage_rank = null, ordered alphabetically
